_what: Text marks painted over a surface without touching its elements (text-highlights.ts): each kind is a CSS Custom Highlight name, drawn by its ::highlight rule in parts/screen-look/show/text-highlights.css. `kinds`: the marks a surface may paint (find: words looked for on the screen; citation: the words an answer quotes; review: words a reviewer marked). `least_word_chars`: shorter words are never looked for. `most_ranges`: the most marks one paint makes. `skip`: elements whose text is never marked (editable fields keep their own selection; code and scripts are not prose).
